user.title: Connect to TeslaPi
user.description: Enter the IP address or hostname of your TeslaPi. You can paste a URL such as http://teslapi.local/.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the TeslaPi Raspberry Pi
data_description.password: Only needed if you set a password in the TeslaPi web UI. Leave empty otherwise.
data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll for status updates (10-300 seconds)

reauth_confirm.title: TeslaPi password
reauth_confirm.description: The TeslaPi at {host} rejected the stored password or now requires one. Enter the password set in the TeslaPi web UI.

discovery_confirm.title: TeslaPi found
discovery_confirm.description: Found a TeslaPi at {host}:{port}. Add it?

data_description.password: Only needed if you set a password in the TeslaPi web UI.

reconfigure.title: Change TeslaPi address
reconfigure.description: Set the primary address of this TeslaPi. Fallback hosts are in the integration options.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the TeslaPi

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the TeslaPi. Check the host and port and that the device is on.
error.invalid_auth: The TeslaPi rejected the password. Use the password set in the TeslaPi web UI.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.
error.invalid_host: Enter an IP address or hostname, for example 192.168.1.50 or teslapi.local.

abort.cannot_connect: The discovered TeslaPi is not responding.
abort.invalid_auth: The discovered TeslaPi needs a password. Add it manually.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll for status updates (10-300 seconds)
data_description.extra_hosts: Other addresses for the same Pi, tried in order when the primary does not answer (for example its Wi-Fi hotspot IP or teslapi.local). They use the same port.
data_description.password: Leave empty to keep the stored password.

error.invalid_host: One of the fallback hosts is not an IP address or hostname.
error.fallback_port: Fallback hosts use the same port as the primary host. Remove the port.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the TeslaPi to check the password.
